exceptions.reason: The new core writes the Gemini reply the same way for every upstream format: the serving model in modelVersion and the upstream reply's id in responseId (GenerateContentResponse reference), one chunk per text or thought delta, and a last chunk holding the finish reason, any function calls and usageMetadata, as Gemini streams end. usageMetadata follows Gemini's inclusion rules (Google's UsageMetadata reference): candidatesTokenCount leaves out thoughtsTokenCount. Today's core writes the model as model, no responseId, counts reasoning tokens in candidatesTokenCount, and sends usage in a separate chunk with no candidates.

The new core's Chat encoder leaves out content on an assistant message that only holds tool calls, as Chat Completions allows, for every client format; today's Gemini-to-Chat translator sends an empty string.

The model carries tool parameters as JSON Schema, so Gemini's Schema type names (OBJECT, STRING) are written in lower case, as JSON Schema spells them; today's core passes them to a Chat upstream in upper case, which JSON Schema validators reject.
